franchise: Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood
summary: Spellbound's stand-alone Robin Hood stealth real-time tactics game in the style of Commandos and Desperados.

entries.title: Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the primary route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PC visuals with modern compatibility fixes.

primary.why: Windows is the original and most accessible version, with modern storefront support and known fixes; Mac, Linux, and MorphOS ports have no exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version from GOG/Steam or another legitimate PC storefront, applying compatibility fixes if modern Windows needs help.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; use compatibility fixes for modern systems.
